entities.summary: The Raman Research Institute (RRI) is an institute for scientific research located in Bengaluru, India. It was founded by Nobel laureate Sir C. V. Raman in 1948. Although it began as an institute privately owned by C. Raman, it became an autonomous institute in 1972, receiving funds from the Department of Science and Technology of the Government of India.
